en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a large, ornate building with a round turret, balconies, and elaborate roof design. The structure is surrounded by landscaped gardens and trees on a sloping terrain. Atop the turret is a cross, suggesting a religious or charitable function. The lower border of the postcard contains handwritten-style text: 'Karlsbad' on the left and 'Evangel. Hospitz.' on the right.
